## Source inspected
The Human Rights Digest PDF on CanLII was read on 20 September 2026. It is a secondary digest, not the reasons for decision. The full *Hutchinson* decisions were not opened in this pass.
:::

## Annotation

The digest states that Hutchinson was accepted as a CSIL client in 1998 and that a ministry policy barred hiring her father as a paid caregiver; the tribunal found discrimination and the digest reports the B.C. Supreme Court dismissed the ministry’s challenge. Those are the digest’s claims.

For this catalogue the 1998 acceptance date is useful only as a later date by which CSIL already existed: a program called CSIL existed by 1998 in this secondary account. It does not settle 1993 versus 1994.

The BCHRT listing confirms the neutral citations. Because the reasons themselves were not retrieved here, do not treat this record as a verified-inspected reading of 2004 BCHRT 58 or 2005 BCSC 1421.
